mintAuthority.summary: USTB is an ERC-1967 upgradeable proxy with issuance controlled by a single issuer EOA that owns both the token and the ProxyAdmin. The EOA custody model is consistent with enterprise MPC/HSM; chain state confirmed unchanged.

review.evidence: At block 25294990: owner() = 0xad309BB6f13074128b4F23EF9EA2fe8552AfCA83, eth_getCode = '0x' (EOA confirmed). ProxyAdmin owner() = same address. Token and ProxyAdmin both confirmed under same issuer EOA. No on-chain roles beyond owner; issuance is issuer-backend via Superstate's fund subscription API. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: NAV Fund Services independently calculates recurring USTB NAV and PwC audits the fund; the current product page exposes continuous NAV per share. The same page states that the fund is not registered under the Investment Company Act, and its Rule 506(c)/Section 3(c)(7) filing is not prudential supervision. 2026-07-20 follow-up: the token is a transparent proxy (EIP-1967 implementation 0x1f50a1ee0ec8275d0c83b7bb08896b4b47d6e8c4, admin 0xb9d285dcad879513dc9c1a3b2e0cccb21c3c2146) whose ProxyAdmin owner() = 0xad309bb6f13074128b4f23ef9ea2fe8552afca83, matching the reviewed control; the proxy admin can change mint-critical logic with no on-chain delay. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the issuer EOA controls token ownership and the ProxyAdmin and can replace mint-critical logic without delay; existing periodic reconciliation and attestation-only supervision remain supported.
